format: terrain.bin = uint16 LE height[nz][nx] (world units = value * heightQ), then uint8 surface[nz][nx] (0 land, 1 sand, 2 sea). Row j is z = z0 + j*step (north first), column i is x = x0 + i*step.
rimLiftFormat: sub-grid of the main grid (i0, j0, w, h): how far a cliff cut lowered each node, in heightQ steps; rimAt = groundAt + this (the ground as if the cut were not there)
cliffsFormat: cuts the DEM predates (tools/fetch_terrain.py CLIFFS): foot and edge = the sheer face's bottom and top polylines [x,z,...], lookout = level clifftop ring [x,z,...], levels in world units (groundAt)
cutsFormat: rail trench polylines: pts [x,z,...] world units, per-vertex half width hw and depth below groundAt (terrain.js applies them)
